rule: constrain feature at horizon h iff its unconstrained PDP response has the wrong sign with |delta P| >= 0.001 in BOTH the 2020 and 2021 out-of-sample audits (t2020, t2021); val_2022 is never consulted
primary_analysis: per-horizon, because the target set is horizon-specific and may be empty. Each horizon is tested separately against a0 and the placebo arms with the same four criteria. A horizon with an empty target set is a no-op by construction and cannot test the hypothesis; it is reported but not counted as evidence for or against.
secondary_analysis: pooled horizon mean and worst cell, reported descriptively only. The pooled test is not primary because an empty-horizon no-op makes criterion 4 mathematically impossible to pass.

pre_registered_criteria.c1_val2022_ge_a0: horizon val_2022 PR-AUC >= a0_unconstrained at the same horizon
pre_registered_criteria.c2_worst_gt_a0: worst (cell) PR-AUC > a0_unconstrained at the same horizon
pre_registered_criteria.c3_no_cell_regression_gt_0.005: no (cell) more than 0.005 below a0 at the same horizon
pre_registered_criteria.c4_beats_all_placebo_arms: horizon val_2022 > a3_placebo, a4_random and b2_targeted_placebo at the same horizon
pre_registered_criteria.decision: all four must hold; otherwise not supported and D16 stands

test_policy: no test row is read; no test read is authorised by this experiment
